title: Compensation and expenses.
bodyText: Each trustee shall serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed from the fund for any necessary expense incurred in the performance of the trustee's duties.
history: [L Sp 1981 1st, c 7, pt of §1; gen ch 1985]
bodyHtml: [§88E-6]  Compensation and expenses.  Each trustee shall serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed from the fund for any necessary expense incurred in the performance of the trustee's duties. [L Sp 1981 1st, c 7, pt of §1; gen ch 1985]
